content: {"like":["Packaging overall is liked, especially the book style case and laminated sleeves that do not scratch discs","The film looks and sounds great, with no complaints about transfer quality","The Lizard works well visually and in battles, and the action sequences are top notch","Garfield’s portrayal of Spider-Man’s wise‑guy attitude and chemistry with Emma Stone is praised","Emma Stone’s portrayal of Gwen Stacy won the reviewer over","Stan Lee’s cameo is highlighted as the best ever","The relationship between Gwen and Peter and the potential of a third film are standout positives","Bonus material is considered definitive and worth the price"],"dislike":["Hubs would have been a better choice than the laminated sleeves","Subplot about Peter’s parents is tedious and distracting","Garfield’s Peter Parker seems too confident and cool, lacking contrast with alter ego","Aunt May’s portrayal by Sally Field doesn’t give off the Aunt May vibe","Spider‑Man’s origin is rushed and the thug who kills Uncle Ben fades away","Villains in Amazing Spider‑Man 2 are poorly designed, especially Electro’s mask","Osborn disfiguring disease is unnecessary","Green Goblin’s costume is not interesting enough","Rhino’s teaser in the trailer was misleading and not used in the film","The film’s bright tone may be intentional but is noted as a change from the first"]}
